krsna.entities: Kṛṣṇa (Vāsudeva, the Yādava hero/god) vs Kṛṣṇā (feminine: Draupadī, also Kālī/dark forms)

vidura.entities: Vidura (Pāṇḍava counsellor, masc.) vs Vidurā (the heroine of the Vidurā-putra saṃvāda, fem.)

vasistha.entities: Vasiṣṭha (the sage) vs Vāsiṣṭha (patronymic 'descendant of Vasiṣṭha')

bharadvaja.entities: Bharadvāja (the sage) vs Bhāradvāja (patronymic, e.g. Droṇa); 'Bharadvaja' is the unaccented anglicized form of Bharadvāja

phalguna.entities: Phalguna (epithet of Arjuna, masc.) vs Phālguna (relating to the month/asterism Phalgunī)

kasyapa.entities: Kaśyapa (the primeval sage) vs Kāśyapa (patronymic 'descendant of Kaśyapa')

nahusa.entities: Nahuṣa (the king) vs Nāhuṣa (patronymic 'descendant of Nahuṣa', e.g. Yayāti)

surya.entities: Sūrya (the sun-god, masc.) vs Sūryā (the Sun's daughter / feminine solar deity)

angiras.entities: Aṅgiras (the sage) vs Āṅgiras (patronymic 'descendant of Aṅgiras')

citrasena.entities: Citrasena (gandharva/various men, masc.) vs Citrasenā (feminine name)

uttara.entities: Uttara (prince of Virāṭa, masc.) vs Uttarā (his sister, Abhimanyu's wife, fem.)

hidimba.entities: Hiḍimba (the rākṣasa) vs Hiḍimbā (his sister, Bhīma's wife)

kasi.entities: Kāśi (the city/kingdom & its kings) vs Kāśī (feminine/locative form, also princess of Kāśī); risky to merge

bala.entities: Bala (the demon/various masc.) vs Balā (the herb-goddess/feminine name)

kali.entities: Kali (the age/the gambling demon, masc.) vs Kālī (the goddess / dark woman)

kanva.entities: Kaṇva (the sage) vs Kāṇva (patronymic 'descendant of Kaṇva'); 'Kanva' is the unaccented form of Kaṇva

ila.entities: Ila/Ilā (the king who became a woman / progenitor) vs Iḷā (the Vedic libation/speech goddess); distinct lineages and the Vedic form differs

tara.entities: Tāra (the monkey chief / masc.) vs Tārā (Vālī's wife / Bṛhaspati's wife, fem.); 'Tara' is the unaccented form

magadha.entities: Magadha (the country/people) vs Māgadha (the bard caste / 'of Magadha')

maya.entities: Maya (the dānava architect, masc.) vs Māyā (illusion personified / goddess, fem.)

kapila.entities: Kapila (the sage, masc.) vs Kapilā (the cow / feminine name); Kāpila is the patronymic/derivative

sudarsana.entities: Sudarśana (the discus / men, masc.) vs Sudarśanā (feminine name)

gaya.entities: Gaya (the king / the place Gayā ambiguous, masc.) vs Gayā (the sacred town, fem.)

alambusa.entities: Alambusa/Alambuṣa (the rākṣasa warrior, masc.) vs Alambusā/Alambuṣā (the apsaras, fem.); also spelling noise in the stem

kanvas.entities: Kaṇvas (the family/seers of Kaṇva) vs Kāṇvas (the Kāṇva school/descendants); vṛddhi marks the school

angirasas.entities: Aṅgirasas (the Aṅgiras seers) vs Āṅgirasas (patronymic plural 'descendants of Aṅgiras')

arya.entities: Ārya (noble/Aryan, masc.) vs Āryā (the goddess / noble woman, fem.)

jaya.entities: Jaya (Victory, masc. names/attendants) vs Jayā (the goddess / Durgā's companion, fem.)

anjana.entities: Añjana (the elephant / collyrium / masc.) vs Añjanā (Hanumān's mother, fem.); Āñjana is the derivative ('made of/from añjana')

saibya.entities: Śaibya (king/horse of the Śibi people, masc.) vs Śaibyā (Śibi queen/woman, fem.)

sveta.entities: Śveta (the white one / men / mountain, masc.) vs Śvetā (feminine name)

rambha.entities: Rambha (the rākṣasa, masc.) vs Rambhā (the apsaras, fem.)

citrangada.entities: Citrāṅgada (the gandharva / Śaṃtanu's son, masc.) vs Citrāṅgadā (Arjuna's wife, princess of Maṇipura, fem.)

duhsaha.entities: Duḥsaha (a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, masc.) vs Duḥsahā (feminine personification, e.g. in AV)

aruna.entities: Aruṇa (the dawn charioteer / sage, masc.) vs Aruṇā (river/feminine name)

taraka.entities: Tāraka (the asura, masc.) vs Tārakā (the rākṣasī Tāṭakā/feminine, fem.)

danu.entities: Danu (the dānava progenitrix/dānava, and Vedic demon) — the Mbh/Rām usage (a male dānava cursed to a monstrous form) differs from Vedic Dānu; ambiguous gender/referent

indrasena.entities: Indrasena (Nala's son / masc. names) vs Indrasenā (feminine name, e.g. Mudgala's wife)

citra.entities: Citra (masc. names / the asterism) vs Citrā (the asterism/feminine name, fem.)

bhadra.entities: Bhadra (masc. names / 'auspicious') vs Bhadrā (feminine name, e.g. Kṛṣṇa's wife / a river)

satya.entities: Satya (Truth / masc. names) vs Satyā (feminine name, e.g. an epithet of Satyabhāmā)

arati.entities: Arāti vs Arātī — hostility/the demoness of niggardliness personified; masc. and fem. personifications differ in AV contexts

pundarika.entities: Puṇḍarīka (the lotus / men / elephant, masc.) vs Puṇḍarīkā (feminine name); 'Pundarika' is the unaccented form of Puṇḍarīka

trijata.entities: Trijaṭa (a brahmin / a male rākṣasa, masc.) vs Trijaṭā (the kindly rākṣasī who guards Sītā, fem.)

nanda.entities: Nanda (masc. names / serpent / treasure) vs Nandā (river / feminine name)

visakha.entities: Viśākha (Skanda's companion/form, masc.) vs Viśākhā (the asterism, fem.)

renuka.entities: Reṇuka (masc. form) vs Reṇukā (Paraśurāma's mother, fem.); 'Renuka' is the unaccented form

anala.entities: Anala (Fire / a Vasu / masc.) vs Analā (a daughter of Dakṣa, mother of trees, fem.)

ekacakra.entities: Ekacakra (masc., e.g. a dānava) vs Ekacakrā (the town where the Pāṇḍavas stayed, fem.)

dasarna.entities: Daśārṇa (the country/people) vs Dāśārṇa ('of Daśārṇa', derivative); vṛddhi marks the derivative

jarita.entities: Jarita (the male śārṅgaka bird/sage, masc.) vs Jaritā (his wife, the female bird, fem.)

sudharma.entities: Sudharma (masc. name) vs Sudharmā (the divine assembly-hall / feminine name)

jara.entities: Jara (the hunter who killed Kṛṣṇa, masc.) vs Jarā (the rākṣasī 'Old Age' who joined Jarāsaṃdha's halves, fem.)

sumati.entities: Sumati (masc. name, e.g. son of Sagara) vs Sumatī (feminine name, e.g. a wife of Sagara)

jyestha.entities: Jyeṣṭha (masc. 'eldest'/the asterism) vs Jyeṣṭhā (the asterism / the goddess of misfortune, fem.)

pingala.entities: Piṅgala (masc., e.g. a serpent / the year-name / a man) vs Piṅgalā (the courtesan / feminine name)

samkrti.entities: Saṃkṛti (the king/sage, masc.) vs Sāṃkṛti (patronymic 'descendant of Saṃkṛti', e.g. Raṃtideva)

lapita.entities: Lapita (masc. form) vs Lapitā (the female bird, mate of Mandapāla's son context / the kraunchī, fem.)

jivala.entities: Jīvala (Nala's companion in Ṛtuparṇa's service, masc.) vs Jīvalā (a feminine/herb personification in AV)

haidimba.entities: Haiḍimba (patronymic of Ghaṭotkaca 'son of Hiḍimbā', masc.) vs Haiḍimbā ('of Hiḍimbā', fem. forms)

asuri.entities: Āsuri (the sage, masc.) vs Āsurī (the demoness / feminine herb personification in AV)
